p.title: v59.94 four-place FX daily bars rounded high, low and adjusted close to two places
p.symptom: Daily rows for EURUSD, GBPUSD, CNY and AUDUSD kept close at four places but high, low and adjClose at two, so a row could read close 1.1544 with high 1.15, a high below its close.
p.root_cause: dailyRowsFromYahooChart rounded close with closeDigits but hard-coded 2 for high, low and adjClose.
p.fix: high, low and adjClose round with the same closeDigits as close; the default stays 2, so every other instrument is unchanged.
p.violated_rule: One bar's fields share one precision; a rounding step must not reorder high, close and low.
p.prevention: Unit gate builds one bar at closeDigits 4 and asserts high 1.1599, low 1.1501, adjClose 1.1544 and high >= close >= low, and the same bar at the default digits stays at two places.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs exits 0; with the old price-factors.js it fails with high 1.16, low 1.15, adjClose 1.15 on the four-place row.

changelog: **FX bar digits ({P}):** four-place currency bars keep four places in high, low and adjusted close as well as close, so a row no longer reads a high below its close; other instruments are unchanged.
note: v59.94: FX bars keep their close digits
